bottomHtml:
Fiber Stripper – High Precision Tool for Fiber Optic Cable Stripping

The Fiber Stripper is a high-quality tool designed for precisely stripping the outer coatings and jackets of fiber optic cables, making it an essential tool for fiber optic technicians and network installers. Its ergonomic design and sharp, adjustable blades ensure accurate and efficient stripping of single-mode and multi-mode fibers without damaging the core. Whether you're working with 250µm, 900µm, or 3mm cables, this stripper ensures clean, uniform results for a perfect connection every time. Ideal for FTTH installations, telecom, and data networks, this fiber stripper offers both reliability and durability for professional fiber optic work.

Key Features:

  • Precision Stripping: Ensures clean, accurate removal of coatings without damaging the fiber core.
  • Adjustable Blade Design: Can handle a range of fiber sizes, from 250µm to 3mm.
  • Ergonomic Grip: Comfortable and easy to use for extended periods of work.
  • Durable Construction: Built to last in demanding environments, providing long-term reliability.
  • Multi-Use Compatibility: Suitable for single-mode and multi-mode fiber optic cables.
